nodes.norm_label: vat-inclusive gross pricing (net back-computed from a round gross)
nodes.rationale: Moonlight line prices such as 2,520.339, 11,650.8475, 2,605.0847, 22,186.4407 and 2,103.3898 equal a round gross total divided by 1.18, i.e. the agreed fee is a VAT-inclusive round number and the net is derived. Tel Aviv-Yafo (60216) is the exception, priced at a round 14,000 net.

nodes.label: Total rounding to a whole shekel (עיגול)
nodes.norm_label: total rounding to a whole shekel (עיגול)

nodes.label: Deal→Receipt Closing Pattern (300 → 320)
nodes.rationale: Work is billed first with a חשבון עסקה (300). When the client pays, a חשבונית מס/קבלה (320) is issued, normally for the same amount, with the footnote 'עבור חשבון עסקה N' that closes the deal. Revenue and VAT recognition wait until payment, which suits a cash-basis service business.

nodes.label: Israel Invoices Allocation Number (מספר הקצאה)
nodes.rationale: A Tax Authority allocation number is required on tax invoices to VAT-registered customers above a pre-VAT threshold: ₪10K in early 2026, dropping to ₪5K in June 2026. 60222 (pre-VAT ₪22,186) carries 070087816.

nodes.label: VAT-Inclusive (Gross) Pricing — net back-calculated
nodes.rationale: Moonlight show fees are agreed as round gross totals (₪2,482 / ₪13,855 / ₪26,180). The unit price is back-computed as gross ÷ 1.18 to four decimals (e.g. ₪2,103.3898, ₪11,741.5254, ₪22,186.4407). Per-gig musician fees (₪1,250, ₪1,000) and studio hours (₪180), by contrast, are priced net plus VAT.

nodes.label: Whole-Shekel Rounding Line (עיגול)
nodes.rationale: The Hebrew Theatre receipts add a rounding line (+₪0.17 / −₪0.34) so the gross total lands on a whole shekel (₪2,549 / ₪1,274) and matches the original deal amounts.

nodes.label: vendor-mapping.json
nodes.rationale: Vendor registry: name, displayName, emailPatterns, parserFile, category. Its documented categories (כללי, ארנונה, אינטרנט, סלולרי, חשמל, דלק) do not all match the skill's 21-category list.

nodes.rationale: An ambiguous total is flagged needs_review with a reason instead of being guessed.

nodes.label: Model cost tiering (Haiku for simple invoices, Sonnet for scanned images)
nodes.norm_label: model cost tiering (haiku for simple invoices, sonnet for scanned images)
nodes.rationale: About $0.0005 per invoice on Haiku vs about $0.006 on Sonnet; upgrade only for scanned or poor-quality images.

nodes.label: n8n integration method comparison (Claude API text / Claude API vision / SSH-CLI)
nodes.norm_label: n8n integration method comparison (claude api text / claude api vision / ssh-cli)
nodes.rationale: API text is fast and reliable but costs per request; API vision reads scans at higher cost; SSH/CLI reuses the local skill but needs Claude Code installed and is slower, so it suits development/testing.

nodes.label: invoiceType values (חשבונית מס / חשבונית מס קבלה / קבלה, no '/')

nodes.label: payables Agent
nodes.rationale: Never initiates payments: reminders and a prepared payment list only.

nodes.label: Account Manager 2026 Workbook Schema
nodes.rationale: Flat tabs with stable ids, no merged cells and no formulas in data columns, so each tab maps 1:1 to a Postgres table.

nodes.label: n8n Does Plumbing, Agents Do Judgment
nodes.norm_label: n8n does plumbing, agents do judgment
nodes.rationale: Deterministic steps (move file, append row, call API) live in n8n; steps needing reading comprehension or a decision call a Cowork agent.

nodes.label: Google Sheets First, DB Later
nodes.rationale: At ~150-200 documents/year a DB solves no real problem yet; Sheets gives free UI and n8n integration, and a normalized schema keeps migration a one-day job.

nodes.label: Supabase Migration Note
nodes.rationale: Tabs become tables with the same columns and Yearly_Report becomes a SQL view; n8n swaps Sheets nodes for Postgres nodes and agent prompts stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Idempotent Writes & Error Trigger
nodes.rationale: All writes check-by-id before append so reruns are safe; an Error Trigger workflow ensures no invoice is silently dropped.

nodes.label: Credit-to-invoice matching (exact / probable / unmatched)
nodes.rationale: Exact = amount + client; probable = within +/-1% or split/combined payments summing to the open balance. Never mark exact without amount agreement (accounting for withholding).

nodes.label: Debit matching to payables and tax deadlines (verified_paid)
nodes.norm_label: debit matching to payables and tax deadlines (verified_paid)

nodes.label: Paid invoice with no קבלה (receipt) issued in Morning
nodes.norm_label: paid invoice with no קבלה (receipt) issued in morning

nodes.label: ניכוי מס במקור (withholding at source) detection
nodes.norm_label: ניכוי מס במקור (withholding at source) detection
nodes.rationale: Municipalities and institutions deduct tax at source, so a credit of 95-97% of the invoice is a probable match; the withheld amount is flagged so it is recorded for the annual report.

nodes.label: Payables row for unpaid invoices with terms (חשבונית עסקה / שוטף+N)
nodes.norm_label: payables row for unpaid invoices with terms (חשבונית עסקה / שוטף+n)

nodes.label: Committed outgoing vs. current bank balance warning
nodes.norm_label: committed outgoing vs. current bank balance warning

nodes.label: Weekly payment checklist (overdue / due this week / due within 30 days)
nodes.norm_label: weekly payment checklist (overdue / due this week / due within 30 days)

nodes.label: Paid-but-not-closed invoice check (לסגור חשבונית ולהפיק קבלה)
nodes.norm_label: paid-but-not-closed invoice check (לסגור חשבונית ולהפיק קבלה)
nodes.rationale: An invoice may be paid without being closed in Morning; in that case no reminder is drafted.

nodes.label: Reminder email escalation tiers (friendly / direct / firm)
nodes.norm_label: reminder email escalation tiers (friendly / direct / firm)
nodes.rationale: +1..+14 days friendly nudge, +15..+30 direct with bank details, +30 or reminder_count >= 2 firm. Never threaten legal action: these are ongoing relationships in a small industry.

nodes.label: Tax deadlines sweep (מע״מ 15th bi-monthly, ביטוח לאומי 15th monthly, annual return)
nodes.norm_label: tax deadlines sweep (מע״מ 15th bi-monthly, ביטוח לאומי 15th monthly, annual return)
nodes.rationale: The annual-return date comes from outlook.deadline.file_by; when deadline.stated is false it is the default online-filing date, not the CPA quota date. Adjust for Shabbat/חג postponements.

nodes.label: Expense document gaps (Partner March, water, gas, ועד בית, electricity confirmations, HOT Mobile April)
nodes.norm_label: expense document gaps (partner march, water, gas, ועד בית, electricity confirmations, hot mobile april)

nodes.label: Cowork agents (.claude/agents/)
nodes.rationale: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is said to cover six agents, but only five agent definitions are listed (invoice-intake, bank-reconciler, tax-compliance, receivables, payables).

nodes.label: Escalate credits still unmatched after 3 days
nodes.norm_label: escalate credits still unmatched after 3 days
nodes.rationale: Unmatched credits are escalated rather than silently left open.

nodes.label: Request missing חשבונית מס/קבלה after a supplier is paid
nodes.norm_label: request missing חשבונית מס/קבלה after a supplier is paid
nodes.rationale: Missing documents mean lost VAT input and lost deductions.

nodes.label: Payables never moves money (checklists and reminders only)
nodes.norm_label: payables never moves money (checklists and reminders only)

nodes.label: שוטף+30 due-date rule (end of invoice month + 30 days)
nodes.norm_label: שוטף+30 due-date rule (end of invoice month + 30 days)
nodes.rationale: The due date is the end of the invoice month plus 30 days, not the invoice date plus 30.

nodes.label: Municipality/institution slow-payment allowance (chase at terms+14)
nodes.rationale: Municipalities and non-profits have slow payment cycles; reminders reference הזמנת רכש / מספר ספק when known.

nodes.label: deduct_pct business-use ratios (car 45%, home-office utilities 15%, phone/internet 80%, direct business 100%)
nodes.norm_label: deduct_pct business-use ratios (car 45%, home-office utilities 15%, phone/internet 80%, direct business 100%)
nodes.rationale: Ratios are taken from scripts/parse_expenses.py so the agent and the batch parser deduct identically.

nodes.label: Missing musician/subcontractor invoice detection (קבלנות משנה - נגנים)
nodes.norm_label: missing musician/subcontractor invoice detection (קבלנות משנה - נגנים)
nodes.rationale: Subcontracted musicians are the biggest expense category; a gig with a revenue invoice but no matching musician invoices means lost deductions.

nodes.label: 2026 expense summary by category (49 files, 84,638 NIS total, 77,215 NIS deductible)
nodes.norm_label: 2026 expense summary by category (49 files, 84,638 nis total, 77,215 nis deductible)
nodes.rationale: Computers above 500 NIS are depreciated over their useful life; the 399 NIS item is fully deducted.

nodes.label: app Service (expose 3000)
nodes.rationale: Uses expose, not ports: reachable from cloudflared but not the host network, since publishing 3000 would bypass the tunnel.

nodes.label: CI Workflow (tsc lint, vite build, node tests)
nodes.norm_label: ci workflow (tsc lint, vite build, node tests)

nodes.label: aiagent Account & Forced Command (am-agent wrapper)
nodes.rationale: The wrapper matches SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND but never executes it; it is a root-owned copy so a git pull cannot change what the key can run.

nodes.label: Deploy Secrets (DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS pinning)
nodes.rationale: Pinned host keys mean a hijacked DNS record or changed IP gets a refused connection instead of the deploy key.

nodes.label: Oracle Cloud Always Free VM (Ampere A1)
nodes.norm_label: oracle cloud always free vm (ampere a1)

nodes.label: Claude Code on the VM (personal use)
nodes.norm_label: claude code on the vm (personal use)

nodes.label: AI Agent over SSH (prompt on stdin)
nodes.norm_label: ai agent over ssh (prompt on stdin)
nodes.rationale: The app holds a key to one fixed command on another machine, so no AI API key exists in the container, database or any browser-visible error; the prompt never touches a command line and nothing the agent says takes effect.

nodes.label: Two-Workspace Shell (data-ws attribute)
nodes.rationale: Business and Moonlight are separate books, so they get separate navigation and accent colours hung off one data-ws attribute; colours are named by purpose so no page hard-codes a palette.

nodes.label: Agent Hardening (--tools "", --strict-mcp-config)
nodes.rationale: Prompts carry campaign names and ad copy collected from Meta; an agent summarising that text has no business holding Bash and Edit on the VM.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Tunnel (outbound-only)
nodes.rationale: OCI has two independent firewalls (security list and iptables); an outbound-only tunnel needs neither and never exposes the VM's IP.

nodes.label: Stateful Node + SQLite WAL Hosting Constraint
nodes.norm_label: stateful node + sqlite wal hosting constraint
nodes.rationale: better-sqlite3 writes a real file in WAL mode and sessions live in it, so it needs a persistent disk and long-running process, ruling out Workers/Pages without a D1 rewrite.

nodes.label: Show Page (/moonlight/shows/:id)
nodes.rationale: One page per show replaced three tables (income / show expenses / staffing) that forced reading across tabs to assemble a gig's numbers.

nodes.label: Synced Title Cleaning (show words, leading keywords)
nodes.norm_label: synced title cleaning (show words, leading keywords)

nodes.label: Account Manager Web App
nodes.rationale: Unified accounting dashboard replacing the Google Sheets workbook: personal freelance accounting (clients, works, invoices) plus Moonlight band finance in one app, with an external API for the Morning app.

nodes.label: AM-* Local Invoice Numbering
nodes.rationale: Morning owns sequential numbers; numbering locally would hand out numbers Morning will issue, and creating local rows first left abandoned AM-* invoices that looked issued.

nodes.label: Client Deletion Guards
nodes.rationale: A client holding invoices is refused (billing history would point at nothing); a client fed by an enabled calendar rule is refused because the next sync would recreate it; uninvoiced works are deleted only on explicit request.

nodes.label: Event Expense Row: Clear vs Delete
nodes.norm_label: event expense row: clear vs delete
nodes.rationale: Every show owns exactly one expense row, so deleting an attached row empties it (keeps it to type into) while an unattached legacy row is deleted outright.

nodes.label: Title-only Keyword Matching
nodes.rationale: Descriptions carry running orders that contain the keyword without saying whose show it is; searching them pulled four Karni Band gigs into the band rule.

nodes.label: Shows Come Only From the Calendar
nodes.norm_label: shows come only from the calendar
nodes.rationale: A quote never creates a show; it puts an event on the band calendar and the sync makes the show exactly as for any other event.

nodes.label: סקירה Dashboard Overview (overview.ts)
nodes.rationale: A running period ends today, so year-to-date is compared against the same window last year rather than a full twelve months.

nodes.label: Expense Recognition Rates (expense_recognition_rates)
nodes.rationale: Per-category deductible shares (45% car, 15% household bills, 80% communications) taken from expense-inventory-2026.md; defaults overridable in settings.

nodes.label: מס הכנסה Income Tax Estimate
nodes.rationale: Follows the real order: ביטוח לאומי on profit, 52% of it deducted, brackets applied, נקודות זיכוי off the tax; explicitly an estimate.

nodes.label: TAX_RATES (server/reports.ts)
nodes.rationale: Pinned to the year they were published for and reported next to the figures, so a stale table is visible rather than silently wrong.

nodes.label: דוח שנתי מקוצר עוסק זעיר 2025 Template
nodes.norm_label: דוח שנתי מקוצר עוסק זעיר 2025 template

nodes.label: Accrual Basis (מצטבר)
nodes.rationale: An Israeli VAT filing reports a document in the period it was issued, whether or not the money arrived.

nodes.label: Bank transaction classification (client_payment / supplier_payment / tax_vat / tax_bituach_leumi / tax_income / bank_fee / personal / other)
nodes.norm_label: bank transaction classification (client_payment / supplier_payment / tax_vat / tax_bituach_leumi / tax_income / bank_fee / personal / other)
nodes.rationale: Bank descriptors are truncated/garbled Hebrew, so matching against known client and vendor names must be fuzzy. Personal transactions are classified and ignored without commentary.

nodes.label: CompanyTypes enum coverage (14 banks + 4 card companies, israeli-bank-scrapers >= 6.7.x)
nodes.norm_label: companytypes enum coverage (14 banks + 4 card companies, israeli-bank-scrapers >= 6.7.x)

nodes.label: MCP server coverage notes
nodes.rationale: Not every upstream scraper is exposed by every MCP wrapper, so check the tool list before assuming an account is reachable.

nodes.norm_label: bank scraper authentication (2fa/otp, ~15-30 min sessions, rate limits)

nodes.rationale: Docker-based with SQLite storage and built-in spending analysis; less actively maintained and pins an older scraper version.

nodes.label: israeli-bank-scrapers (npm library)
nodes.rationale: Uses headless-browser scraping, not official Open Banking APIs.

nodes.label: Israeli spending categorization (diur, mazon, tahaburah, shartuim, briut, chinuch, bilui, bituach, chisachon)
nodes.norm_label: israeli spending categorization (diur, mazon, tahaburah, shartuim, briut, chinuch, bilui, bituach, chisachon)

nodes.label: Supported Israeli banks and credit-card companies reference
nodes.norm_label: supported israeli banks and credit-card companies reference

nodes.label: Bank data is read-only (never initiate transfers)
nodes.norm_label: bank data is read-only (never initiate transfers)
nodes.rationale: The agent never initiates, schedules, or suggests executing transfers.

nodes.label: Categorization tips (abbreviated merchants, card-company descriptors, horaot keva, ATM = cash)
nodes.norm_label: categorization tips (abbreviated merchants, card-company descriptors, horaot keva, atm = cash)

nodes.label: Out of scope: payment initiation, transfers, investment advice
nodes.norm_label: out of scope: payment initiation, transfers, investment advice

nodes.label: Israeli Open Banking (Berlin Group NextGenPSD2) gotcha
nodes.norm_label: israeli open banking (berlin group nextgenpsd2) gotcha
nodes.rationale: Agents may cite UK Open Banking or generic PSD2 endpoints that do not exist in Israel; the rollout is still ongoing in 2026.

nodes.label: Separate scraper connections (Mercantile, Otsar HaHayal, credit-card companies)
nodes.norm_label: separate scraper connections (mercantile, otsar hahayal, credit-card companies)
nodes.rationale: Subsidiaries have their own loginFields and card statements come from Isracard/Max/CAL rather than the bank, so each needs its own connection.

nodes.label: מה דורש טיפול Inbox (/api/inbox)
nodes.rationale: Every item is derived from the books on each load, so an item disappears by being dealt with, never by being dismissed.

nodes.label: Deposit Percent ({deposit})
nodes.rationale: A percentage rather than a sum, so it follows the price with nobody retyping it.

nodes.label: QuoteDocument Single Renderer
nodes.rationale: Used by both preview and public page, so what is previewed is what gets signed.

nodes.label: Quote Money Calculation (quoteMath)
nodes.rationale: Totals recomputed server-side on every save, discount before VAT, VAT rate frozen at creation so later rate changes do not rewrite sent quotes.

nodes.label: Quotes_Creator_System (Base44 app)
nodes.rationale: Not ported: guessable Q-<timestamp> links, publicly writable Quote entity, UTC expiry, VAT defaulting to 17%, duplicates copying signatures.

nodes.label: Sign Validation Checks (version, consent, PNG < 300 KB)
nodes.norm_label: sign validation checks (version, consent, png < 300 kb)

nodes.label: Signing → Show Linking (quoteShow.ts, afterSigning)
nodes.rationale: Runs after the signature commits so a bookkeeping failure never fails the client's signature; it only fills a show with no amount.

nodes.label: Derived Quote Expiry (Asia/Jerusalem)
nodes.rationale: Expiry is computed, never stored, at the end of the last day Israel time; moving valid_until later reopens the quote.

nodes.label: Native Rebuild over Base44 Sync or JSX Copy
nodes.norm_label: native rebuild over base44 sync or jsx copy
nodes.rationale: One login and one database, signing writes straight into band_events, and the public surface is one token-scoped API instead of a publicly writable entity; copying JSX would drag in shadcn/Radix and ~40 unused deps.

nodes.label: SQLite Online Backup to Cloudflare R2
nodes.norm_label: sqlite online backup to cloudflare r2
nodes.rationale: Uses sqlite3 .backup rather than cp because under WAL a plain copy can miss recent commits; integrity_check runs before upload.

nodes.label: band_quote_items Table
nodes.rationale: Items are rows, not a JSON column, because they are reordered and edited; the signed snapshot is the one place JSON is right.

nodes.label: Built-in Templates (Coldplay tribute, Eilat by car / by plane)
nodes.norm_label: built-in templates (coldplay tribute, eilat by car / by plane)

nodes.label: WCAG Contrast Guard for Brand Colours
nodes.norm_label: wcag contrast guard for brand colours
nodes.rationale: Header text picks white or near-black by contrast and the accent is darkened only to 4.5:1, so no colour choice can make a quote unreadable.

nodes.label: Quote Files Stored in DB
nodes.rationale: deploy/backup.sh copies only the database file, so a logo or signature on disk would be the one thing a restore came back without.

nodes.label: get_annual_report MCP tool (דוח שנתי)
nodes.rationale: Covers every income source through deductions, brackets and credits down to יתרה לתשלום. The app computes it from the books, so the agent reads it instead of re-deriving figures from the sheets.

nodes.label: get_tax_report MCP tool (מע"מ periods)
nodes.rationale: Its income-tax half prices business profit as the only income, badly understating tax for someone who also draws a salary, so it is used for VAT only.

nodes.label: Annual report outlook (balance, shortfall, payments, mikdamot_paid, deadline, configured)
nodes.norm_label: annual report outlook (balance, shortfall, payments, mikdamot_paid, deadline, configured)
nodes.rationale: If configured is false the declared side (salary, מילואים, withholding, advances) was never filled in, so the balance is meaningless and the agent asks for טופס 106 and certificates.

nodes.label: מקדמות מס (income-tax advances) check
nodes.rationale: A shortfall found in August can still be discussed with the accountant; the same gap found next June is a lump sum plus ריבית והצמדה. freelancer-profile.json says advances are NOT REQUIRED, but the filed 2025 return shows 46,066 NIS paid, so the claim must be re-verified.

nodes.label: YTD 2026 P&L draft (revenue 90,857 NIS, net 13,642 NIS)
nodes.norm_label: ytd 2026 p&l draft (revenue 90,857 nis, net 13,642 nis)
nodes.rationale: Excludes open receivables #50095 and #40221; assumes 15% home office, 45% car and 80% phone/internet.

nodes.label: VAT input (מס תשומות) check for Mar-Apr (filing 2026-05-15)
nodes.norm_label: vat input (מס תשומות) check for mar-apr (filing 2026-05-15)
nodes.rationale: Input VAT at 18% is reclaimable on deductible business expenses only.

nodes.label: Advise; the accountant decides (לבדוק מול רואה החשבון)
nodes.norm_label: advise; the accountant decides (לבדוק מול רואה החשבון)
nodes.rationale: A deadline is never marked paid without bank evidence or explicit user confirmation.

nodes.label: Per-year tax-rate pinning (assessment.rates_year / rates_note)
nodes.rationale: Brackets change yearly: quote the year the app used and flag rates_note. Lines marked הערכה (estimated) are approximations, not assessed figures.

nodes.label: Revenue Document Types (docTypes.ts: 305, 320)
nodes.rationale: A sale yields both a 300 and a 305 carrying the full amount, so only 305/320 count as revenue to avoid counting it twice.

nodes.label: הוצאות Expenses Page (read-only Morning mirror)
nodes.rationale: Expenses are entered and classified in Morning; the app only shows them beside the income they are set against.

nodes.label: expenses.raw Payload Retention
nodes.rationale: Keeps the Morning payload each row was mapped from so a field Morning spells differently can be seen rather than guessed at.

nodes.label: monthlyPnl Shared P&L Query (ExpenseBasis)
nodes.rationale: One query with one ExpenseBasis argument so the VAT and income-tax reports cannot drift except on which date they use.

nodes.label: Two-Step Morning Issue Dialog (morning-draft)
nodes.rationale: An issued document cannot be deleted, only credited, so issuing goes through a preview step rather than a bare confirm.

nodes.label: דוח מע"מ VAT Report
nodes.rationale: Counts an expense in Morning's reporting_date period so the input VAT claimed agrees with what Morning reported.

nodes.label: Havila Cover Sheet Jan–Apr 2026
nodes.rationale: Accountant hand-off summary: 19 issued docs, ₪92,037 revenue, ₪70,823 deductible expenses, net VAT payable ₪3,236.03.

nodes.label: סטטוס לא ידוע Expense Status
nodes.rationale: A real third state instead of a tidier default: mislabelling unrecognised payloads as טרם דווח was both wrong and invisible.

nodes.label: Spent vs Deductible Expense Figures
nodes.rationale: Anything that claims money back counts deductibleAmount/deductibleVat; anything about money that left the business counts the full figures; the gap is real money that cannot be reclaimed.

nodes.label: app lint & build job (npm ci -> lint -> test -> build on Node 22)
nodes.norm_label: app lint & build job (npm ci -> lint -> test -> build on node 22)
nodes.rationale: Node 22 matches deploy/Dockerfile so CI fails on what production would fail on; the tests cover the quote arithmetic a client signs.

nodes.label: Container HEALTHCHECK readiness wait
nodes.rationale: The app is not published on a host port, so the image HEALTHCHECK is the only readiness signal and cloudflared waits on the same condition. Dangling images are pruned because the free-tier disk is small.

nodes.label: verify job (reuses ci.yml on the commit being shipped)
nodes.norm_label: verify job (reuses ci.yml on the commit being shipped)

nodes.label: SSH pull & docker compose rebuild on the VM (/opt/account-manager)
nodes.norm_label: ssh pull & docker compose rebuild on the vm (/opt/account-manager)
nodes.rationale: Deploys the exact verified SHA rather than whatever master is by now; reset --hard keeps untracked deploy/.env; pinned known_hosts so a hijacked DNS record cannot collect the key.

nodes.label: CI workflow (lint & build)
nodes.rationale: Only the app has a build; the Python scripts and JSON ledgers have nothing to check. The concurrency group is keyed on the workflow so the push CI run and Deploy's verify call do not cancel each other.

nodes.label: Deploy workflow (production)
nodes.rationale: Automates the git pull && docker compose up -d --build from deploy/README.md, only when app/, deploy/, invoices_2026.csv or the workflows change. One deploy at a time, never cancelled mid-build.

nodes.label: Carrefour - Global Retail K.Y. (M.D.) Ltd, Hod HaSharon branch (vendor)
nodes.norm_label: carrefour - global retail k.y. (m.d.) ltd, hod hasharon branch (vendor)
nodes.rationale: Scanned thermal-till receipt kept inside the invoice-expert skill folder as a sample/test input for vendor-specific parsing: 59.50 NIS gross = 50.42 taxable at 18% + 9.08 VAT, paid by Isracard magnetic card, addressed to Itamar Miron. Its 'allocation number' field is blank because the amount is far below the reform threshold.

nodes.label: Campaign → Show Mapping (weights, suggestions)
nodes.rationale: Campaign names are written for people and a campaign promoting a run of shows cannot be divided by rule, so the sync proposes and a person confirms.

nodes.label: Monthly Meta Invoice vs Per-Show Ad Cost Partitions
nodes.norm_label: monthly meta invoice vs per-show ad cost partitions

nodes.label: Moonlight Member Division (three steps)
nodes.rationale: Shows the working, not just the total, so each member's figure can be checked rather than trusted; refunds are kept separate from profit share.

nodes.label: Producer Fee (computeDivision, commission_percent)
nodes.rationale: Default 20% (30/30/20/20); already-paid shows were stamped 40% on migration so the boot recompute would not silently re-divide settled money.

nodes.label: Hand-typed קמפיין Figure Lock
nodes.rationale: Pre-integration figures are history; rewriting them would move what the band is owed on shows already divided.

nodes.label: Settled Show Freeze (שולם לנגנים)
nodes.rationale: Campaigns outlive shows; without freezing, later spend would re-divide profit already paid out to members.

nodes.label: MCP Server (/mcp) Read-only Access
nodes.rationale: Everything exposed is a read: an assistant that could issue an invoice because a web page told it to is a liability.

nodes.label: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP (no SDK)
